final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT AVG(s.avg_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(s.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(s.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_amount_above_overall FROM invoice_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.ratio > o.avg_ratio
